book.name: Rom
book.title: Babam la omirong Paulo me mai ekelesiap onim Rom

content: Inamaniap onim Israel la tale ameit tavuk ang Morowa
Ekelesiap tuam onim Rom, dalap tuo la nameng maset meba ina malagiang Morowa inamaniap onim Israel ga tume busit marik me ai Morowa me urio.

Marit maset ga tume ties la uakap gare ro, Mamaranim migat la mime ameuluan tavuk ang Morowa. Pa tale kan memaning uaraki maset me na migat ang Morowa meba makosarmeng. Ga man omeuluan it agat maiong ga man okosarmeng ubi ang Morowa.

Migat, tale ameit tavuk la auluan Morowa meba buevam teip mila puvuvum. Are ratmat ga man aisinmeng tavuk ila puvuvui na agat maiong kan, pa tale mepto ties ang Morowa meba maidangieng eba betmeng inamaniap mila puvuvum.
Obit, maimai tinan la ualo Morowa aun Moses la oituamu ga ovuoong ara Ila Kakani. Are ratmat ga inamaniap ganam le naganmeng ira Karisito la ume ivam Morowa inamaniap mila puvuvum.

Moses la omirong ties a tavuk me inamaniap la eba akosarmeng ga omeuluan maimai, tie eba evam Morowa inamaniap mila puvuvum. Tiesong gare ro, “Man migana la akosarong iruo tavuk ila puvuvui, eba oala ninimiap ira a.”

Ga avarangemeng Iesu na uro kimanam ga uvara iro maiogun. Are ratmat ga migana la naganong ira Karisito ga iva Morowa irie migana ila puvuvui. Irie tavuk la ouluan uro ties: “Baraba tiesming kan me milam gare ro, ‘Aga la eba ala tatuan na panbinim ula babau?’ Aret tie ga miga ina miniang Karisito me togo lourup.”
Teuara Iesu na una. Are ratmat ga baraba migama ratmat: “Aga leba ala tatang na inamon maiong inamaniap la mevara?” Are tie ga miga ina alagiming Karisito me na una gat.
Pa man muana o uro ties? Oagatbuong ties ang Morowa la tiesieng gare ro:

content.text: “Urio ties ula mumuru la ionama kagarat mi migat. Puoieng le baisming o, ga puoieng leba iot na ninimiap ming.” Lo 30:12-14

content: Memani, urio ties ula mumuru la are ro: Inamaniap le naganmeng ira Karisito. Pame bais o urio ties me maun inamaniap.
Tie, leba baisnang na nanam nuo la uakap a Iesu irie ila Kakani, ga na dalap nuo la nagannung ira Morowa la ina imua Iesu na una, eva eba ina nolagiang Morowa.

Memani, na dalap buo la bume nagan ira Iesu la uvara ga ina imua Morowa na una, ga buiva Morowa inamaniap mila puvuvum. Are gat to, na nanamup buo bume ovaik nagan buong gare ro, “Iesu irie la Kakani”, ga ina bulagiong Morowa.
Memani, unuli Aisaia na Babam ula puaru la tiesong gare ro: “Leba naganmeng inamaniap ira a eba tale omela mulinubap ira a. Karuk. Eba maagaalie Morowa inamaniap ga eba evam mirie la puvuvum.”

Memani, garip onim Iudaia ga mirie non garip la tale onim Iudaia la nevuomeng it na agat ang Morowa. Inamaniap ganam la nagameng ira a la memaning it namurit Ila Kakani, irie Karisito. Ga ume ualo ubonuvarap ula kakanu maun mirier inamaniap ganam la mime amarik meba maagaalie ga ina malagiang.
Migat, Unuli Ioel la tiesong gare ro, “Inamaniap ganam la marikmeng ga ameika Ila Kakani meba maagaalie, eba ina malagiang.”

Are ratmat ga leba tale naganmeng ira a, eba amarikmeng gare ba mani meba maagaalie? Ga leba tale meptang ties ang, eba naganmeng ira gare ba mani? Ga leba karuk ba a noba meba baisang o ties ula mumuru me maun, eba meptang ties gare ba mani?

Ga leba tale masagaang Morowa teip meba baismeng o ties ula mumuru, eba baismeng gare ba mani? Pa mirulo, garip ma teip ga magaulap onim Israel la mepto ra urio ties ula mumuru a Iesu Karisito. Are unuli Aisaia la omirong na Babam ula puaru gare ro, “Teip la maialo ties ula mumuru, migat, mirie la man akosarmeng tavuk ila mumuri migat.”
Inamaniap onim Israel la tale omeuluan ties ula mumuru
Pa tale mirie ganam la omeuluan urio bais ula mumuru. Karuk. Tiesong unuli Aisaia gare ro, “Ila Kakani, karuk a migana ba la naganong iro urio ties ula mumuru la baispang o.”
Are ratmat ga bira bupto ties ang Morowa ga urio la buagailie ga naganbuong ira Karisito.
Pa garip ma inamaniap onim Israel la tale nagameng ira Karisito. Memani? Tale mepto urio ties ula mumuru, a? Karuk. Mepto ra. Muana, non Sam la igama ro,

content.text: “Nuloiap ma nivunap ma la mela ra na inamon gano. Ga tiesiap maiam la mela ra maialu kimanam gano.” Sam 19:4

content: Pa atabo garip ma teip ga magaulap onim Israel la tale omeit urio ties ula mumuru a Iesu Karisito? Karuk. Omeit ara pa maialam ibup ma iro urio ties. Tinan la omirong Moses ties na Babam ula puaru gare ro,

content.text: “Eba ina malagirang noba inamaniap, la tale mirie gar migat, ga eba kiram ba dalap mi me urio ga eba tale naming maset aime tavuk ila mumuri la akosartung ira ma. Ga eba alagirang namurit gar ba ma inamaniap la tale memaning agat, ga eba bukbukming maime.” Lo 32:31

content: Unuli Aisaia gat la tale kan urau ga tiesong maranit gare ro,

content.text: “Inamaniap la tale kan ubimeng meba toisinmeng, la tomaiop ara. Bettung la uakap mai inamaniap la tale kan mamarikmeng noba inamaniap, pa masagarung inamaniap meba tovaikmeng.” Aisaia 65:1

content: Pa Morowa la tiesong me maun Israelip gare ro,

content.text: “Tara ila laklage kan la man ubirung ga man turanam Israelip meba naganmeng ga omeuluan ties tung. Pa mime oguek ties ga mime tomepula o ties ula kiro.” Aisaia 65:2
